column1: # One row per function: PACKAGE<TAB>FUNCTION<TAB>CALLS<TAB>REASON. The check
# lists every function and package-level variable, test files included, in
# internal/workcellhardening that calls strings or bytes Contains, HasPrefix or
# Index, or regexp. CALLS is the number of such calls. A function with no row
# fails, a row whose CALLS differs fails, and a row whose function no longer
# does this fails, so the list only gets shorter.
# Port a "debt" row to ShellInvocations or a closed decoder, then delete it.
# An "unreviewed debt" row came in when the scan widened to every match; give
# it a real reason or port it.
